subject.title: refactor: unify doctor and automatic state migration execution

question: Should this persisted-session migration ordering refactor land after its exact merge head has been re-proven against the mixed existing, imported, ambiguous, and custom-agent ACP upgrade cases?
rationale: The implementation is a compatibility-sensitive change to canonical state migration ordering; positive branch-head proof does not by itself establish safety after the branch is refreshed onto current `main`.

options.title: Refresh and land with upgrade proof
options.body: Rebase the PR, rerun the focused upgrade matrix and built Doctor/Gateway proof on the resulting head, then land if the exactly-once and ownership assertions still hold.

options.title: Pause for migration-owner review
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want to reconsider the migration ownership boundary or the intended behavior for ambiguous ACP rows before accepting the refactor.

recommendation.title: Refresh and land with upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Rebase the PR, rerun the focused upgrade matrix and built Doctor/Gateway proof on the resulting head, then land if the exactly-once and ownership assertions still hold.

likelyOwner.reason: The available commit and proof history ties this person directly to the proposed migration-plan implementation and its stated upgrade invariants.
